rows.note: The judicial record establishes a named acquisition authority, a commercial alternative, a statutory inquiry, a challenge, and a decision requiring compliance before award.
rows.ceil: bounded prospective procurement authority and challenge
rows.next: Acquire the complete pre- and post-injunction acquisition strategy, market research, requirements, decision memoranda, and source-selection chronology.
rows.fals: The operative record shows the challenged inquiry had no material effect on the acquisition path.

rows.note: The Federal Circuit held that the Army had not satisfied the statutory commercial-item inquiry and required compliance before award, while refusing to dictate the winner.
rows.next: Acquire the exact statutory, regulatory, market-research, and acquisition-plan versions applied before and after the judgment.
rows.fals: Later records show the threshold was immaterial or not applied to the final acquisition.

rows.note: The Army could not proceed on the challenged record without satisfying the statutory inquiry; the court did not require Palantir selection.
rows.next: Acquire compliance submissions, revised findings, evaluation records, and any later protest testing whether the burden remained shifted.
rows.fals: The Army proceeded without a new inquiry or the later award was wholly independent of the challenged gate.

rows.note: The court intervention required the Army to correct the acquisition process before award, providing a positive control for prospective counterpower.
rows.next: Acquire the injunction chronology, compliance record, award chronology, and any costs imposed by the delay on each party.
rows.fals: The remedy did not materially precede or constrain the award.

rows.note: The judgment and award notice are public, but the complete acquisition file, proposals, scoring, and source-selection record are not in current custody.
rows.ceil: public judgment plus incomplete acquisition archive
rows.next: Acquire the administrative record, proposals, evaluations, decision documents, and preservation history.
rows.fals: The complete record is public and shows no material custody gap.

rows.note: Palantir generated legal and later procurement evidence; the judgment itself declined to require selection.
rows.ceil: evaluated alternative with unresolved award causation
rows.next: Acquire all bidders, excluded options, evaluation criteria, scores, and unsuccessful-offeror feedback.
rows.fals: No commercial alternative was actually evaluated after the judgment.

rows.note: The court imposed the inquiry and did not grant Palantir a right to selection; exception use is not shown.
rows.next: Acquire waivers, deviations, sole-source findings, clarifications, and requirement changes after the judgment.
rows.fals: Operative records show no exceptions or deviations and symmetric application to all bidders.

rows.note: The public sources establish the gate and later award, not the full distribution of costs, learning, revenue, or performance.
rows.next: Acquire litigation costs, procurement delay effects, award economics, performance, rework, institutional changes, and unsuccessful-alternative costs.
rows.fals: Complete records show proportionate cost allocation and no durable asymmetric learning or benefit.
